title: QueueConfiguration

Id.description: An optional unique identifier for configurations in a notification configuration. If you don't provide one, Amazon S3 will assign an ID.

QueueArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Amazon SQS queue to which Amazon S3 publishes a message when it detects events of the specified type.

Events.description: A collection of bucket events for which to send notifications

description: Specifies the configuration for publishing messages to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue when Amazon S3 detects specified events.
